entities.summary: Leandro Marconi (1834–1919) was a Polish architect, active mainly in Warsaw. His father was Enrico Marconi, also a famed architect associated with that city, while his cousin was Leonard Marconi, a sculptor. Leandro Marconi was a architects & engineers from Warsaw (1834-04-23, Warsaw–1919-10-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
